steps.content: [Scene, Abyss] (Black scene is sufficient)
You are falling.
Your body is melting, your mind blending into the black Abyss.
A strange sense of comfort fills you with a deeper dread.
It was you who led the crew into the Abyss. They trusted you, depended on you, and you delivered them into the Abyss's maw.
You didn't want to do this.
You never want to, so why... Deep down, are you really connected to the Perishing Star...
Countless red lights appear before your eyes, their dying screams echoing in your ears.
The red light tears through a corner of the Abyss. Through the filthy, twisted ripples, you see a distant Illusory Moon. A familiar, eerie laughter rings in the depths of your mind.

Hehe. You should've listened to me from the start. I invited you, offered you my power. You could've devoured it by becoming me, but you... you're always so stubborn. So arrogant. So sure of yourself. Yet when it matters most, you falter...
That's why you couldn't even defeat that half-dead wretch... You were crushed...
The shackles shatter, and the vortex below sucks you in. Abyssal filth overwhelms your vision, blocking the light. As its laughter fades, the Illusory Moon vanishes too.
You reach out, struggling with all your strength, and several twisted figures coalesce from the chaos.
[Corrupted DisSea group portraits with black gradient]
They look so familiar, so comforting. They reach out to you...
Many hands seize you at once, clawing up your arms, licking and tearing at your skin, yearning to merge with you, to become one.

steps.speaker: Companions
steps.content: I don't want to die...! You're our guide! Take us back!!
You scream in terror, but no sound comes. You try to flee, but in your path stands a woman, arms wide open, pulling you into her embrace.
She holds you tight, shielding you from every attack, soothing your fear with gentle whispers. Her voice trembles with ecstatic joy.
It's alright, don't be afraid. You have always been closer to the Abyss than anyone. Don't fear the unknown, don't fear sacrifice.
This is the guidance of fate. You and I were destined to meet again. This is its greatest gift to me... Come, my guide, let us go together...
Only YOU know the way back.
You are It...
Create a proper earring pendant visual effect; the previous ones were all terrible. Use an earring image or small model, whatever works, just make a decent one.
[Sound effect: a single piano note, see if there's any classical/thematic note available, stretch it out—]
[White flash] Full black screen, 2 seconds, pay attention to sound effects, add ambient sound of an empty environment without music.
You are consumed.
Or perhaps you've fallen through a rift.
There is no light. No sound. No one. You feel no ground beneath your feet, no walls, no ceiling. You're suspended, adrift in a vacuum, or the deep sea, or...
[Faint piano sound, slow, distant, emphasize the sound effect]
The notes are pensive and far away, like the sigh of a long-lost friend. You pull yourself up shakily and follow the sound...
[Fade to full white screen, exit after 1 second]
